about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Azerbaijani Dovga Yoghurt and Herb Soup with Chickpeas
recipes.summary: A warm, tangy Azerbaijani-style soup of yoghurt, rice, chickpeas and plenty of fresh herbs.
steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the rice and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 12 minutes until the rice is tender, then add the chickpeas.

Whisk the yoghurt, egg and flour in a bowl, then whisk in a ladle of hot soup. Stir this back into the pan over low heat for 5 minutes until slightly thickened and steaming; do not let it boil hard or it may split.
Stir in the spinach, dill, coriander, mint and salt and cook for 2 minutes until the greens are just wilted.
notes: Whisking the yoghurt with flour and egg first helps it stay smooth in the hot pot.
Food safety: heat the soup until steaming hot throughout so the egg is cooked.

recipes.title: Madagascan Romazava Greens and Beef Broth
recipes.summary: A brothy Madagascan-style stew of tender beef, ginger, tomato and silky greens, served with rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef in two batches over high heat for 5 minutes until coloured all over.
Add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 3 minutes until fragrant, then stir in the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they break down.
Add the water, salt and pepper, cover and simmer gently for 45 minutes until the beef is tender.
Stir in the bok choy and spinach and cook for 4 minutes until the greens are soft. Serve in bowls with steamed rice.
notes: Brown the beef well for a deeper broth.
Food safety: cook the beef until tender and at least 75°C inside, and the broth is steaming hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Colombian Lentil and Pumpkin Soup with Coriander and Lime
recipes.summary: A hearty lentil soup with pumpkin, tomato and cumin, finished with coriander and lime.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and carrot over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic and cumin for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the lentils, pumpkin, tomatoes and stock.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 25 minutes until the lentils and pumpkin are tender.
Season with the salt and lime juice, scatter with coriander and serve hot.
notes: Mash a few spoonfuls against the side of the pot for a thicker soup.
Rinse the lentils well before cooking.

recipes.title: Pakistani Haleem-Style Lentil and Beef Porridge
recipes.summary: A thick, spiced porridge of beef, lentils and barley, cooked slowly and topped with ginger, lemon and coriander.
steps: Melt the ghee in a heavy pot and cook the onion over medium heat for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add the beef, garlic, ginger, garam masala and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes until the beef is browned.
Add the lentils, barley, water and salt, cover and simmer gently, stirring now and then, for 75 minutes until the beef is falling apart and the porridge is thick.
Beat the mixture with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes until the meat breaks into strands, then serve with lemon and coriander.
notes: Add a splash of hot water if it thickens too much.
Food safety: cook the beef until very tender and at least 75°C inside, and the porridge is steaming hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until piping hot.

recipes.title: Hungarian Tarhonya-Style Browned Orzo with Onion and Paprika
recipes.summary: Orzo toasted until nutty, then simmered with onion and sweet paprika as a Hungarian-style side.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the orzo and stir for 4 minutes until lightly browned and nutty, then stir in the paprika for 30 seconds.
Pour in the hot stock and salt, cover and simmer on low for 10 minutes until the orzo is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork, scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Take care not to burn the paprika; it turns bitter if scorched.
Delicious beside roast chicken or grilled sausages.

recipes.title: Yemeni Maraq Lamb Soup with Fresh Herbs
recipes.summary: A clear, gently spiced Yemeni-style lamb soup with potato, tomato and a handful of fresh herbs.
steps: Place the lamb, onion, garlic, cumin, turmeric, pepper and water in a large pot and bring to a simmer, skimming the surface until clear.
Cover and cook gently for 45 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the potato is soft.
Scatter with coriander and serve with lemon wedges.
notes: Skim well for a clean-tasting broth.
Food safety: cook the lamb until very tender and at least 75°C inside, and the soup is steaming hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Israeli Hamin-Style Barley and Bean Stew
recipes.summary: A slow-simmered stew of barley, beans, potato and sweet paprika, rich enough to serve as a main.
steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and cook the onion for 8 minutes over medium heat until golden.
Add the garlic, paprika and cumin and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the barley, beans, potato, carrot, stock, honey and salt, cover and simmer on low for 90 minutes until the barley is soft and the stew is thick.
Stir in the parsley and serve hot.
notes: Stir now and then so the barley does not catch on the base.
It tastes even better the next day.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Brinjal Moju Pickled Eggplant
recipes.summary: Fried eggplant folded through a sweet-and-sour onion pickle, served as a side with rice and curries.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and fry the eggplant in two batches for 8 minutes until golden and soft, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil, onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the mustard, turmeric and chilli, then add the vinegar, sugar and salt and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Fold the eggplant through until coated and cook for 2 minutes until heated through. Cool and serve.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days and improves with time.
Dry the eggplant well before frying to keep the oil from spitting.

recipes.title: Indian Upma with Vegetables and Mustard Seeds
recipes.summary: Savoury semolina porridge cooked with vegetables, mustard seeds and lemon, a quick south Indian breakfast.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat and add the mustard seeds until they pop.
Add the onion, ginger and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the semolina and stir for 3 minutes until lightly toasted, then pour in the hot water and salt, add the peas and stir constantly for 3 minutes until thick and the semolina is cooked.
Stir through the lemon juice and coriander and serve at once.
notes: Add the water slowly while stirring to avoid lumps.
Top with roasted peanuts for crunch.

recipes.title: Indian Vegetable Dalia Cracked Wheat Porridge
recipes.summary: A warming porridge of cracked wheat simmered with vegetables, cumin and turmeric.
steps: Melt the ghee in a saucepan and add the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the turmeric and bulgur for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and salt, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until the bulgur is tender and the water is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork, stir through the peas and coriander for 2 minutes until the peas are hot, and serve with yoghurt.
notes: A spoon of lemon pickle on top is a classic addition.
Leftovers reheat well with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Pakistani Breakfast Chickpea Curry with Flatbread
recipes.summary: A spiced tomato chickpea curry, eaten with warm flatbread, from the Pakistani breakfast table.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes over medium heat until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until thick.
Stir in the chickpeas, water and salt and simmer for 10 minutes until saucy.
Scatter with coriander and serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan for a minute each side.

recipes.title: Maldivian Mas Huni Tuna and Coconut Breakfast
recipes.summary: Canned tuna tossed with coconut, onion, lime and chilli, a fast Maldivian-style breakfast eaten with flatbread.

items: 2 x 95g cans tuna in springwater, drained (190g)

steps: Mix the tuna, coconut, onion, chilli, lime juice and salt in a bowl, breaking the tuna into flakes with a fork.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan for 1 minute each side until soft and lightly blistered.
Spoon the tuna mixture onto the flatbreads and serve straight away.
notes: Soak the desiccated coconut in a splash of warm water for 5 minutes for a softer texture.
Food safety: use tuna from a sealed, in-date can and eat within 2 days of opening if refrigerated.

recipes.title: Iraqi Eggs with Tomato and Sumac
recipes.summary: Eggs gently cooked in a garlicky tomato base with sumac and parsley, served with bread.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, sumac, cumin and salt and simmer for 6 minutes until the tomatoes collapse into a sauce.
Make four wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook gently for 4 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are as firm as you like.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
notes: Keep the heat low so the eggs cook evenly.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set and the yolks thickened; avoid runny eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Egyptian Ta'ameya-Style Chickpea Falafel with Dill
recipes.summary: Baked herb-packed chickpea patties with dill, coriander and sesame, served with tahini and salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray with baking paper.
Blitz the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices, flour, baking powder and salt in a food processor until a rough, sticky mixture forms.
Shape into 12 patties, press into the sesame seeds, place on the tray and brush with oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp. Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and a little water and drizzle over to serve.
notes: Pat the chickpeas dry well so the patties hold together.
Serve with tomato, cucumber and flatbread.

recipes.title: Somali Canjeero Pancake with Honey and Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Thin, spongy Somali-style pancakes drizzled with honey and a little sesame oil.
steps: Whisk the flour, semolina, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water into a smooth thin batter and rest it for 20 minutes until bubbly.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Pour in a ladle of batter and cook for 2 minutes until the top is covered in holes and dry, without turning.
Repeat with the rest of the batter, drizzle with honey and sesame oil and serve warm.
notes: Cook on one side only so the top stays spongy.
Stack the pancakes under a clean tea towel to keep them soft.

recipes.title: Tanzanian Chapati Rolls with Beans
recipes.summary: Soft pan-cooked chapati rolled around a spiced tomato bean filling.
steps: Mix the flour, salt, 1 tbsp oil and the water into a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes until smooth, then divide into 4 balls.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 8 minutes until thick, then stir in the coriander.
Roll each ball thin and cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes per side until golden spotted and cooked through. Spoon in the beans and roll up.
notes: Rest the dough for 15 minutes for softer chapati.
Serve with a little chilli sauce.

recipes.title: Senegalese Lakh Yoghurt and Couscous Pudding
recipes.summary: Couscous folded through creamy vanilla yoghurt, a cool Senegalese-style breakfast pudding.
steps: Place the couscous and butter in a bowl, pour over the boiling water, cover and stand for 5 minutes until the water is absorbed, then fluff with a fork.
Cool for 10 minutes, then fold in the yoghurt, sugar, vanilla, nutmeg and sultanas until creamy.
Chill for 30 minutes and serve cold in bowls.
notes: Add a little milk if you prefer a looser pudding.
Top with chopped nuts for crunch.

recipes.title: Guyanese Roti with Chana
recipes.summary: Soft pan-cooked roti with a mild curried chickpea filling.
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, oil and warm water into a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes until smooth, then rest for 20 minutes and divide into 4 balls.
Cook the onion in a little oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the chickpeas, potato and water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender and the curry is thick, then mash lightly and stir in the coriander.
Roll each ball thin and cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until puffed and flecked. Serve the chana with the roti.
notes: Brush the hot roti with a little oil for softness.
Keep the cooked roti wrapped in a tea towel.

recipes.title: Bajan Cou Cou with Steamed Greens
recipes.summary: A smooth cornmeal and okra mash, served with lightly steamed greens.
steps: Simmer the okra in the water and salt for 8 minutes until tender, then lift out and set aside, keeping the water.
Mix the cornmeal with 250ml cold water, stir into the hot okra water and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, beating with a wooden spoon, until thick and smooth.
Fold the okra and butter through until combined and shape into a mound.
Sauté the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the silverbeet and 2 tablespoons water and steam for 4 minutes until wilted, then serve with the cou cou and lime.
notes: Beat constantly to avoid lumps.
Traditionally served with fish or stew.

recipes.title: Colombian Arepa de Huevo
recipes.summary: Corn arepas split open and filled with a soft-cooked egg, baked in the oven for easy cooking.
steps: Mix the cornmeal, water and salt into a dough, rest for 5 minutes, then shape into 4 thick discs.
Brown the discs in a pan with the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, then bake at 180C for 15 minutes until they sound hollow.
Cut a pocket in the side of each arepa, add a quarter of the cheese and crack in an egg, then bake for 8 minutes until the egg white is fully set.
Scatter with chives and serve warm.
notes: Keep the pocket small so the egg stays inside.
Food safety: bake until the egg white is completely set and the yolk is thickened; avoid runny eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Argentine Revuelto Gramajo Egg and Potato Scramble
recipes.summary: A comforting scramble of crisp potato, ham, onion and eggs.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the potato over medium heat for 12 minutes, stirring, until golden and tender.
Add the onion and ham and cook for 4 minutes until the onion is soft.
Pour in the eggs, salt and pepper and stir gently over low heat for 3 minutes until the egg is just set and no liquid egg remains.
Scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Parboil the potato first if you want it crisper.
Food safety: cook eggs until set with no liquid egg remaining; avoid undercooked eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Mexican Champurrado-Style Corn Porridge
recipes.summary: A thick, warm corn porridge with cocoa and cinnamon.
steps: Whisk the cornmeal with the water in a saucepan until smooth.
Add the milk, sugar, cocoa, cinnamon stick, vanilla and salt and cook over medium heat for 12 minutes, whisking, until thick and smooth.
Remove the cinnamon stick and ladle into mugs or bowls.
notes: Whisk constantly to prevent lumps.
Use a little extra milk if the porridge thickens as it stands.

recipes.title: Swedish Oven Pancake Ugnspannkaka with Apple and Cinnamon
recipes.summary: A big, golden oven pancake baked with sliced apple and cinnamon.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C and melt the butter in a 26cm ovenproof dish in the oven for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, sugar and salt into a smooth batter.
Scatter the apple over the dish, pour over the batter, sprinkle with cinnamon and bake for 30 minutes until puffed, golden and cooked through in the centre.
Serve hot, cut in wedges.
notes: Do not open the oven in the first 20 minutes so it rises well.
Food safety: bake until the centre is fully set with no wet batter.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka with Zucchini and Herbs
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in a green sauce of zucchini, spinach, herbs and a little chilli.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat until soft, then add the garlic, zucchini, chilli, cumin and salt and cook for 5 minutes until the zucchini is soft.
Add the spinach and stock and cook for 3 minutes until the spinach is wilted, then stir in the parsley.
Make four wells in the mixture, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are as firm as you like.
Scatter with feta and serve with bread.
notes: Squeeze the grated zucchini dry so the sauce is not watery.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set; avoid runny eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Roasted Capsicum and Olives
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in a smoky roasted capsicum and tomato sauce with olives.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Add the garlic, capsicum, tomatoes, paprika, cumin and salt and simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then stir in the olives.
Make six wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks as firm as you like.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
notes: Use jarred roasted capsicum for speed.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set; avoid runny eggs for young children, pregnant women and older adults.

recipes.title: Carrot and Raisin Slaw with Yoghurt Dressing
recipes.summary: A crunchy carrot and cabbage slaw with sweet raisins and a lemony yoghurt dressing.
steps: Toss the carrot, cabbage, raisins and parsley in a large bowl until combined.
Whisk the yoghurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, honey and salt in a small bowl until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the slaw and toss until coated, then chill for 15 minutes before serving.
notes: Add toasted sunflower seeds for crunch.
Best eaten within 2 days.
